props.gloss_en: the mishna: one may clear away first tithe whose teruma was taken [on Shabbat]
it is needed only where [the Levite] took it first while on the stalks, and terumat maaser was taken from it but teruma gedola was not
first tithe that [the Levite] took first while on the stalks is exempt from teruma gedola
as it says: 'a tithe from the tithe' (Num 18:26) -- a tithe from the tithe I told you, not teruma gedola and a tithe from the tithe
Abaye: against you the verse says, 'from all your gifts you shall set apart' (Num 18:29) -- [tithe taken first from the pile owes teruma gedola]
this [tithe taken from the pile] has become grain
and that [tithe taken on the stalks] has not become grain

supports.gloss_en: וכי הא דאמר רבי אבהו אמר ריש לקיש -- in accordance with Reish Lakish: first tithe taken on the stalks is exempt from teruma gedola
שנאמר מעשר מן המעשר -- a tithe from the tithe, not teruma gedola and a tithe from the tithe

objections.gloss_en: אמר ליה רב פפא לאביי: אי הכי, אפילו הקדימו בכרי נמי ליפטר! -- if 'a tithe from the tithe' excludes teruma gedola, tithe taken first from the pile should be exempt too

answered_by.gloss_en: עליך אמר קרא: מכל מתנותיכם תרימו -- another verse obligates the tithe taken from the pile (= p_abaye_mikol_matnoteichem)

objections.gloss_en: ומה ראית? -- what did you see [to apply 'from all your gifts' to the pile and 'a tithe from the tithe' to the stalks]?

answered_by.gloss_en: האי אידגן והאי לא אידגן -- this has become grain and that has not (= p_abaye_kri_idgan, p_abaye_shibolim_lo_idgan)
